improvements.title: Form-based editing for Infrastructure Resources
description: Infrastructure Resources created from a Marketplace item that defines a JSON schema now keep their **form** after creation: the JSON schema of the selected item version is applied to validate the resource not only when it is first added, but also on every subsequent edit.

You can still switch to the YAML editor for more advanced changes; if the manifest no longer matches the JSON schema of the item version, switching back to the form is disabled. Once a resource is detached from the Marketplace, only the YAML editor is available.
Check the [Infrastructure Resources documentation](/docs/products/console/design-your-projects/custom-resources/custom-resources#update-an-infrastructure-resource) for more details.
